name: desktop-continuity
description: Read-only access to Codex sessions recorded by desktop-continuity and to tasks imported from another computer, so Claude can continue them.
long_description: Serves the recordings that desktop-continuity's Codex plugin writes (one redacted, size-bounded event per prompt, tool call, tool result and turn end) and the task handoffs imported with Session Capsule. Every tool is read-only. Install the Codex plugin to record sessions; see the repository README.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List Codex desktop sessions recorded by desktop-continuity, most recent first.

tools.name: get_checkpoint
tools.description: Compact checkpoint for one recorded session, separated into observed facts, agent notes and inferences.

tools.name: get_source_status
tools.description: Fresh check of the source session: end-of-turn events, ChatGPT app process, transcript activity and usage-limit signals.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Compact rows of recorded events after a sequence number.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full stored detail of one event, already redacted and size-bounded at capture.

tools.name: list_project_files
tools.description: List a directory inside the session's recorded project directory (read-only).

tools.name: read_project_file
tools.description: Read part of a text file inside the session's recorded project directory.

tools.name: list_imports
tools.description: List task handoffs imported from another computer (via Session Capsule), newest first.

tools.name: get_imported_checkpoint
tools.description: Checkpoint of a task handed over from another computer, with its historical source status.

tools.name: get_imported_events
tools.description: Compact rows of the events recorded on the source computer, in their original order.

tools.name: get_imported_event
tools.description: Full detail of one event recorded on the source computer.

tools.name: list_imported_project_files
tools.description: List a directory inside the project folder chosen on this computer for an imported task (read-only).

tools.name: read_imported_project_file
tools.description: Read part of a text file inside the project folder chosen on this computer for an imported task.
